title: TailNLG: A Multilingual Benchmark Addressing Verbalization of Long-Tail Entities
authors: Lia Draetta; Michael Oliverio; Virginia Ramón-Ferrer; Pier Felice Balestrucci; Flaviana Corallo; Carlos Badenes-Olmedo; Alessandro Mazzei; Marco Antonio Stranisci; Rossana Damiano
why_relevant: Introduces a multilingual RDF-to-Text benchmark for long-tail entities, mentioning RAG and model uncertainty but focused on data-to-text verbalization rather than RAG robustness.
why_not_or_caveat: Not about retrieval robustness, conflict, adversarial corruption, or calibration in RAG; only tangentially mentions RAG.
